array.string: cd "${FACTORY_ROOT:-$HOME/Develop/factory}" && { code=0; bun orchestrator/queue.mjs --repo factory --gate triage || code=$?; if [ "$code" -eq 1 ]; then echo "factory: triage gate idle; no event admitted"; exit 0; elif [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$code"; fi; bun -e 'const [type,repo,loop]=process.argv.slice(1);const at=new Date().toISOString();const outcome=await (await import("./lib/emit-event.mjs")).emitFactoryEvent(type,{repo},{eventId:`schedule:${loop}:${repo}:${at}`,subject:repo,occurredAt:at});if(!outcome?.admitted&&!outcome?.duplicate)throw new Error("event runtime refused or unreachable");console.log(JSON.stringify(outcome))' factory.triage.requested factory factory-triage; }
